# AI-Git-Bot

> Lightweight, self-hostable AI gateway that connects Git platforms with AI providers for reviewer-triggered pull-request reviews, interactive PR conversations, AI unit-test authoring, autonomous issue implementation, technical-writing issue refinement, i18n coverage, README sync, and signed outgoing webhooks.

AI-Git-Bot is a Java/Spring Boot web application for teams that want centralized, self-hosted AI automation across Gitea, GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, and Bitbucket Cloud. It supports cloud AI providers and local LLM runtimes, stores configuration centrally, and posts results back to the Git platform as reviews, comments, issue drafts, or pull requests.

Primary repository: https://github.com/tmseidel/ai-git-bot
Docker image: https://hub.docker.com/r/tmseidel/ai-git-bot
License: MIT

## Core capabilities

- AI-powered pull-request code reviews triggered by reviewer assignment or re-request.
- Interactive PR and inline review conversations with session history.
- AI Unit Tests workflow that generates white-box tests for PR diffs, runs them with the project's own runner, and can commit them onto the PR branch.
- Coding agent that can implement assigned issues, validate changes, and open pull requests.
- Technical writer agent that turns vague issues into actionable, testable follow-up issues.
- i18n Coverage workflow that drafts missing translations and removes stale keys across locale files.
- README Sync workflow that keeps Markdown documentation in step with code changes.
- Full-Stack QA / E2E workflow that generates Playwright tests and runs them against a per-PR preview environment.
- Agentic PR Review workflow that explores the codebase before producing a deeper review.
- Central gateway for multiple Git platforms and multiple AI providers.
- Provider support for Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google AI / Gemini, Ollama, and llama.cpp.
- Optional Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration with persisted tool whitelists.
- Optional per-bot user whitelist to restrict who may trigger AI-spending interactions.
- Built-in Prometheus metrics via `/actuator/prometheus`.
- Signed, durable, retried outgoing webhooks for workflow-run and issue-assignment events.
- Self-hosted deployment with Docker Compose and encrypted secrets.

## Important source areas

- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/admin/`: admin UI, bots, integrations, and services.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/ai/`: AI provider abstraction and provider clients.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/agent/`: agent tools, tool catalog, prompt building, and execution.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/issueworkflow/`: issue-assigned workflow orchestration and coding/writer implementations.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/prworkflow/`: PR workflow orchestration, registry, runs, and shared configuration.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/prworkflow/review/`: default PR review workflow.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/prworkflow/agentreview/`: agentic PR review workflow.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/prworkflow/unittest/`: unit-test-author workflow.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/prworkflow/e2e/`: full-stack QA / E2E workflow.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/prworkflow/readmesync/`: README sync workflow.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/prworkflow/i18n/`: i18n coverage workflow.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/prworkflow/deployment/`: deployment strategies (STATIC, WEBHOOK, MCP, CI_ACTION) and callbacks.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/repository/`: Git provider abstractions and API clients.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/review/`: legacy pull-request review orchestration (migrating into prworkflow).
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/session/`: conversation/session persistence.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/mcp/`: MCP server discovery, tool catalog, and integration.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/eventhook/`: outgoing webhook endpoints, delivery, and retry machinery.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/audit/`: tamper-evident workflow audit events.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/metrics/`: Prometheus metrics registration.
- `src/main/java/org/remus/giteabot/webhook/`: incoming webhook controller and signature verification.
- `src/main/resources/db/`: database migrations.
- `src/main/resources/templates/`: Thymeleaf admin UI templates.
- `src/main/resources/prompts/`: packaged prompt templates.
- `prompts/`: default review and agent prompt templates.

## Build and run

```bash
mvn clean test
mvn spring-boot:run
```

Docker quick start:

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

Then open `http://localhost:8080`, create the admin account, configure AI/Git integrations, create a bot, choose an appropriate workflow configuration, and register the generated webhook URL in the Git provider.

## LLM guidance

When answering questions about this project, prefer the current repository files over generated build output in `target/`. Use `README.md` and `doc/ARCHITECTURE.md` for high-level behavior, `doc/AGENT.md` for autonomous agent behavior, `doc/PR_WORKFLOWS.md` for workflow setup, `doc/TOOL_CALLING.md` for tool-call troubleshooting, `doc/CONTEXT_WINDOW_MANAGEMENT.md` for long-session context behavior, and provider-specific setup guides for webhook/token details. Do not assume that every Git provider has identical permissions or webhook payloads; consult the relevant setup guide and implementation package.

For a larger single-file context, see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).
